scope_notes: We check rain, heat, cold, snow, wind and recent rain. We don't yet check thunderstorms, hail, freezing rain or ice, wildfire, air quality, coastal flooding, or geological hazards. For those, follow official warnings.
Thunderstorms are not checked. Storms are a major cause of weather deaths — follow official storm warnings.
The history data is a ~25 km grid and misses very local storms.
Groundtruth covers weather-driven hazards only. For landslides, glacier collapse or earthquakes, check local civil protection and geological authorities.

reply.headline: Typical weather in Paiporta, Valencia, Spain on 15 May 2024, with recent rain as the deciding check.
why: Recent rain was the deciding check: normal rain for the last 6 days (0.3 mm), made up of 0.2 mm over the 5 days before and the forecast for the day itself.
Totals like this happen about 45 times a year here now, against about 51 times a year in 1951–1980.
This does not make the day any less serious, because the level is based on the recent 30 years, 1994–2024.
Normal wind for here (gusts up to 34 km/h) and normal highs for here (feels like up to 22 °C).
